title: Matthew 17:1-9 — The Mount of Transfiguration
description: A cell fellowship study on seeing Jesus clearly, hearing Him fully, and following Him faithfully — with group discussion questions.
author: ROLCC Fellowship Team

sections.heading: Observe
sections.body: Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a high mountain. There His appearance changed — His face shone like the sun and His clothes became dazzling white. Moses and Elijah appeared, talking with Him. Peter offered to build three shelters, but a bright cloud overshadowed them and God's voice spoke: "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Hear Him!" The disciples fell on their faces in fear. Jesus came and touched them, saying, "Arise, and do not be afraid." When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus alone.

sections.heading: Interpret
sections.body: The transfiguration was not Jesus becoming someone else — for a moment, the disciples saw His true divine glory. Moses (the Law) and Elijah (the Prophets) pointed to Jesus as the fulfilment of all Scripture. God's command to hear Jesus means He is greater than every other voice. The mountain experience was not an escape from life but preparation for the valley ahead. Peter's instinct to build tabernacles shows how easily we try to preserve a spiritual moment instead of obeying what God is saying.

sections.heading: Apply
sections.body: God often separates us from distractions before He gives revelation. We need prayer, Bible reading, worship, and quiet time — not only on special days, but as a way of life. Worship Jesus. Trust Him. Put Him first. Obey His Word. Walk with Him daily, and face your challenges with faith. The transfiguration was not about changing Jesus — it was about changing how the disciples understood Him.

discussionQuestions: If Jesus invited you to spend one whole day alone with Him, what would you ask Him?
What part of this story impacted you most?
What voice distracts you most from hearing Jesus?
What mountain experience has strengthened your faith?
What valley are you currently facing, and what is one thing Jesus is asking you to obey this week?

activities.title: Closing prayer
activities.body: Lord Jesus, open our eyes to see You more clearly, open our ears to hear You more faithfully, and give us hearts that will follow You completely. Amen.

quiz.question: Who appeared with Jesus on the mountain?
quiz.explanation: Moses and Elijah talked with Jesus, representing the Law and the Prophets.

quiz.question: What did God's voice from the cloud say?
options: This is My beloved Son; hear Him!
quiz.explanation: The Father confirmed Jesus' identity and commanded the disciples to listen to Him.

quiz.question: What was Peter's response on the mountain?
options: He offered to build three shelters
quiz.explanation: Peter wanted to preserve the moment by building tabernacles.

quiz.question: What did Jesus do when the disciples were afraid?
options: He touched them and told them not to be afraid
quiz.explanation: Jesus came to them with compassion and comfort.

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the transfiguration for the disciples?
options: To reveal who Jesus truly is before the cross
To replace the need for faith
quiz.explanation: The event prepared them to understand Jesus' glory and obey His voice.
